analysis.note: Marks across all 5 cases (125). You attempt 4, so you face about 100 of these.
insights: Every paper tested all seven subjects. No subject averaged more than 21 of the 125 marks on offer, so you cannot skip a subject by choosing cases.
Law + Costing together carried 24 to 39 marks in every paper (out of 125).
Most repeated: IDT Input Tax Credit (16 questions), DT PGBP (Business Income) (10), AFM Forex Exposure & Risk Management (11), Law FEMA (7).
FR is spread over 22 different Ind AS in 36 questions: no Ind AS came more than 3 times, so for FR the index matters more than any important-topics list.
